acceptanceCriteria.text: The Runtime Appliance artifact certified by the Route 3/Golden Path job is either passed unchanged into publication or publication proves exact digest/size equality with the certified artifact before release.
Certification evidence records the canonical raw identity and immutable OCI identity that publication must preserve.
Release publication fails closed if the artifact selected for publication differs from the certified identity.
Deployment descriptor generation/binding uses the exact published-and-certified Route 3 artifact identity.
Release evidence makes the chain `certified artifact -> published artifact -> descriptor reference` mechanically auditable.
Rebuilds, retries, and separate workflow jobs cannot silently replace the certified Runtime Appliance with semantically assumed-equivalent bytes.
Regression/workflow tests cover mismatch rejection and successful exact-identity handoff.
The same principle applies to any future projection artifact only when that artifact is claimed as certified; projection formats must not replace the canonical Runtime semantic authority.

issue.title: fix(release): preserve certified Runtime Appliance identity through publication
